name: Houndmaster Loksey
summary: In the Scarlet Monastery's Library wing, Houndmaster Loksey keeps the Crusade's war dogs ready. He breeds and trains them to hunt undead, intruders, and those the Crusade judges heretics. His harsh discipline has made the Monastery's beasts feared across Tirisfal Glades.

sections.title: Master of the Kennels
sections.body: Houndmaster Loksey trains vicious dogs to track and attack. The Scarlet Crusade sends them to sniff out plague-tainted corpses, uncover hidden infiltrators, and run down survivors fleeing the zealots' wrath. Loksey commands the hounds guarding the Library wing. They stand ready to tear intruders limb from limb.

sections.title: Family Rivalry
sections.body: Loksey's brother, Huntsman Leopold, serves the Scarlet Crusade as its envoy to the Argent Dawn at Light's Hope Chapel. In private, Leopold thinks Loksey can barely manage his hounds, let alone handle high-stakes diplomacy. Yet Loksey remains a key officer in the Monastery's inner hierarchy.

faq.q: Where can Houndmaster Loksey be found?
faq.answer: Houndmaster Loksey can be found in the Library wing of the Scarlet Monastery in northeastern Tirisfal Glades, surrounded by his attack dogs.

faq.q: What role does Loksey serve in the Scarlet Crusade?
faq.answer: Loksey is the Scarlet Crusade's chief animal handler and houndmaster at the Monastery. He breeds, trains, and directs war dogs that sniff out undead and hunt intruders.

faq.q: Who is Huntsman Leopold to Loksey?
faq.answer: Huntsman Leopold is Loksey's brother. He represents the Scarlet Crusade at Light's Hope Chapel and looks down on Loksey, believing he cannot manage his hounds or handle diplomacy.

faq.q: Why does the Scarlet Crusade use hounds?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade trains vicious hounds to track the Scourge and Forsaken by scent, guard the Monastery's grounds, and tear fleeing enemies to pieces.

faq.q: Is Loksey considered a leader of the Scarlet Monastery?
faq.answer: Yes. Loksey is a key commanding figure in the Scarlet Monastery's military structure. He oversees the Crusade's war hounds in the Library wing.

faq.q: Are the hounds dangerous on their own?
faq.answer: Yes. Bred for aggression and trained by Loksey, the Monastery's war hounds can rip an armored intruder limb from limb in moments.

angles.text: Loksey trains beasts with brutal force. His fierce hounds obey zealotry, not mutual respect.
As a Forsaken, beware Loksey's hounds. They are trained to catch the scent of dead flesh and alert the Crusade's garrisons.
